cohort: 262 mothers who delivered in No. (13), Military Hospital (100) Bedded between November 1, 2014 and October 31, 2015, with 64 (24.4%) being adolescents (<19 years) and the remaining being adults (20-34 years).
finding: Adolescent mothers had significantly higher rates of inadequate antenatal visits, positive serology at antenatal visits, anemia, PROM, eclampsia, emergency C-sections, poor Apgar scores, and low birth weight babies compared to adult mothers.
birth_weight: Low birth weight mentioned as an outcome, but no specific weight ranges provided.
